target_customer: Developers and teams running multiple AI agents that need a shared workspace instead of per-agent virtual machines
problem: Agents using computer-use run in separate VMs by screenshots and clicks, which is slow, costly and brittle, and agents must message each other to coordinate.
business_model: Open source Linux operating system with a hosted cloud and desktop offering; pricing not stated

founders.name: Xaver Emmerling
education: Computer science via early admission at Technical University of Munich, started at 15

founders.name: Quinten Wolff
education: Early admission to computer science, Technical University of Munich
founders.background_notes: Built a patent workflow automation platform at BDPE per YC page.

competitors.name: Tasklet
competitors.what: Cloud agent operating system for knowledge work, YC listed

competitors.name: PilotDeck
competitors.what: Open source agent OS with workspaces and MCP support from OpenBMB
competitors.traction_then: Few stars reported on GitHub listings

technical_complexity.rationale: Building an OS with typed actions, shared live state, undo and permissions for agents is deep systems work for two founders. Benchmark claims (29x cheaper, 90x faster) are company numbers, not verified.

defensibility.rationale: If apps adopt the typed action model it could lock in an ecosystem, but it is open source and the concept is easy to imitate for well-funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown. Many projects and funded startups used the agent OS label by late 2026.

market_need_then: Computer-use agents were known to be slow and expensive, and MCP had become the common interface, but commentary in 2026 argued no true AI operating system existed yet.

branding.domain_note: Uses tilo.so. A PyPI package named tilo and other projects share the name.

identity.visual_style: Lowercase wordmark, written tilo, Tilo and Tilo OS
identity.voice_and_tone: Playful and bold: computing should be fun, the computer is yours; YC tagline calls it the Microsoft of the AI era

branding.brand_signature: Stated beliefs that working together beats working alone and the computer is yours

brand_strength.rationale: New brand with a distinct tone on its own site but no outside press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Tilo is an active Fall 2026 company with no outcome yet. It pursues an ambitious technical idea with a two person team in a field that already had funded agent OS efforts. No funding beyond YC is public, so its trajectory cannot be judged.
notes: Funding search found nothing on Tilo itself; no cross-check possible. Tasklet and Sycamore dates are from search snippets. The YC page says early admission at TUM; ages not stated.
